name: @remonta/schemas
description: The shared contract between server, web and a future mobile client: Zod schemas for every API input and form, the types derived from them, domain enums and reference data.

scripts.quality: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck:strict && pnpm run test

//scripts: quality is lint-only, on purpose. The 15 pre-existing type errors in the moved schema files are ALREADY tracked in apps/app/.quality-baseline/typescript.txt, recorded there as ../../packages/schemas/src/schema/* -- apps/app type-checks this package through its imports. Adding a second strict tsc here would either fail on errors that are already accounted for, or require a duplicate baseline to keep in sync with the first. The job this gate exists to do is enforce the P-1..P-5 boundaries, and that is what lint does. typecheck:strict is the exception, and deliberately narrow: it type-checks only files written after U7 (listed in tsconfig.strict.json), so new code is held to strict tsc without re-checking the tracked debt. Add a new file there when you create it.
